Then need to fill until G disappears again? Not clear.

Then pressing SPACE reduces G (fills? actually reduces G). Let's count G after each press: after first reset, G=1. After second SPACE, G=2. So G increases with SPACE. So game_over occurs when G disappears (i.e., goes to 0). So we need to reduce G to 0. But pressing SPACE increases G, not decreases. So maybe we need to press something else to reduce G. Perhaps ACTION7 reduces? Let's test ACTION7 now.
